8.o: The clock is ticking as Dr. Blue performs an emergency C-section on a mother with two puppies stuck in her uterus, while Dr. Ross and Dr. Lavigne work on pets with serious eye issues. The vets test their on-camera skills to create a video for the clinic.

1.o: Episode 1. Pilot
Martin Scorsese, Jane Goodall and others reflect on the power of love and the profound connections that have shaped their journeys.

2.o: What does it mean to dream? A woman revisiting her ancestors’ past, an 88-year-old skydiver and a pioneer in climate science share their perspectives.

3.o: Perseverance helps a South African photographer, a surfing pioneer and the mother of a freedom fighter realize their life purpose.

4.o: A 90-year-old shoemaker in Vietnam, a Nigerian artist and a celebrated chef in Jerusalem help to show the dignity and rewards of hard work.

1.o: First-year high school students Kana, Reimi, and Hibiki are apprentices at the Karasuma Phoniatric Clinic, where the power of healing through song is combined with conventional medicine. One day when the girls' teacher is out, one of the clinic's patients takes a sudden turn for the worse. Is there nothing these apprentices can do to help?

2.t: Can I Take a Picture? Or Maybe a Video?
2.o: Sonia Yanagi, a C-rank healer who sees Ria as a rival, meets up with Kana to take her measure. While they're out, they find a pregnant woman suffering in the park. Sonia begins treatment with Kana as her assitant, but when the woman's condition takes a turn for the worse...

3.o: After a study party and lots of prayer, the girls take their provisional license exam! But the minute the test is over, they feel completely drained. Ria takes them out to the town's annual sports day to cheer them up... where they happen to run into Sonia, who has competition in mind!

4.t: First Steps, Horror, and a First Job
4.o: Having passed their provisional license exam, the girls are called in to support a surgeon with their song. But before they accept the job, they have some training to do...

5.t: Blue Skies, Green Mountains, River Battles and the Galaxy Station
5.o: The girls of the Karasuma Phoniatric Clinic visit Hibiki's family in the country. While wandering the countryside, the girls' friendship grows deeper as they learn more about Hibiki's past and the reason they each became healers.

6.t: Become My Servant • Russian Food and Sweet Dreams
6.o: The Karasuma Girls help out at the Honosaka Clinic where they see a surprisingly hard-working side of Sonia. But it turns out Sonia also has plans for Kana at their school's upcoming culture festival...

7.t: A Culture Festival Full of Surprises
7.o: The culture festival is a huge success! ...Or so it appears. At the last moment, something happens to threaten the final stage performance. Can the healer girls step in to fill the hole in the schedule?!

8.o: Reimi's caregiver, Aoi, has received an invitation to follow her dream of studying piano overseas. When she seems reluctant to take it, Reimi takes action of her own.

9.t: The Best Guarantee • Buy the CD
9.o: The girls have been asked to support Ria during a surgery... but the patient is Ria's old teacher, and the hospital's director! Despite their nerves, the girls are determined to give it their best shot!

10.o: Halloween is just around the corner and the girls aim to make the event memorable. But first everyone needs to go shopping!

11.t: Sharks and Training Camp! Let's Climb Together!
11.o: The three apprentices of Ria Karasuma are about  to become true healer-sisters, but as the test approaches, they can no longer sing harmoniously. Ria therefore offers to send them to a training course, under the benevolent supervision of Aoi.

12.o: Having passed the exam to become a C-rank cured-sister, the apprentices of the Karasuma clinic go on a training course each on their own. Reimi will train in Sonia's clinic and Hibiki will work in the hospital. Kana goes much further, to the United States, to pursue her dream.

1.o: Mickey Mouse has his work cut out for him as he tries to wrangle a prized herd, but Peg-Leg Pete gets in the way.

2.o: Mickey, Donald, and Goofy experience tomorrow's tech after sneaking into Von Drake's latest invention.

3.o: Mickey experiences frustration and trouble when he attempts to get Pluto to swallow a simple little pill.

4.o: Mickey Mouse has a difficult time trying to let Gubbles go on his first day of school and must find a way to cope.

5.o: Mickey Mouse and his friends' roller disco night is thrown into jeopardy by Peg-Leg Pete and his gang.

6.o: Micky Mouse has his work cut out for him when he attempts to turn the Big Bad Wolf into a better person.

7.o: Mickey dreams of being a knight but discovers his new boss' heroic reputation is a fairytale.

8.o: Mickey and Minnie are hard at work trying to make their ordinary dinner date into something extraordinary.

9.o: Mickey and his friends’ plans for a barbeque get sidetracked after a quick trip to the supermarket turns into an odyssey.

10.o: Donald and Daisy's little lie becomes a big problem when they try to get out of a group date.

11.o: When several ghosts are left without a home to haunt, Mickey invites them to stay, but they prove to be the worst houseguests.

12.o: Mickey and Minnie struggle to build a shelter after a raging storm threatens to destroy their idyllic island paradise.

13.o: Mickey and Minnie seek to make everyone happy by playing an adorable duet.

14.o: When Minnie’s quest to photograph an elusive bird places Mickey in danger, she must venture to save him before the bird’s motherly instincts seal his doom.

15.o: Bellboys Mickey, Donald, and Goofy seek to revive a rundown hotel’s future after being put in charge for the night.

16.o: When Minnie misplaces Mickey’s gift of love, she must defeat a lover’s lane to retrieve it.

17.o: Crewmates Mickey and Minnie seek to find a buried treasure before Peg-Leg Pete uses it to become the most powerful pirate on the seven seas.

18.o: Mickey scrambles to rescue Minnie after accidentally making her disappear with a magic wand.

20.o: Mickey’s friends are placed in jeopardy after he attempts to spice up their weekly game night.

1.t: The Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant Is Submerged
1.o: March 11, 2011; 225 kilometers from Tokyo, a 15 meter high tsunami hits the Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Station, damaging one of the cooling systems.

2.o: While still unable to get an assessment of the situation from Fukushima Daiichi, the government tells the public to stay calm and remain in their homes.

3.o: Pressure in the containment vessel starts to rapidly rise. With a catastrophic explosion imminent, TOEPCO suggests releasing the gas into the atmosphere.

4.t: It Would Mean Turning Our Backs on Fukushima
4.o: With the power still down, the valves will have to be opened manually. With heavy hearts, some workers ask if they can evacuate to a safer location.

5.t: Our Company Has Lost Its Mind
5.o: Station Manager Yoshida decides to use seawater as a cooling source, but TOEPCO headquarters tells him to wait for authorization from the administration.

6.t: I Can No Longer Leave Here Alive
6.o: When pressure in the containment vessel finally starts to decrease, TOEPCO headquarters want on-site workers to get back to work, but Yoshida is wary.

7.o: As the administration and TOEPCO headquarters grow increasingly impatient, Station Manager Yoshida asks for permission to evacuate some on-site workers.

8.o: The Prime Minister is informed that in a worst case scenario, a third of the country — including the Tokyo area — will become uninhabitable for decades.

1.t: It's Time to Shake Things Up
1.o: As The Monday Night War comes to a close, WWE reckons with the challenges that arise from its acquisition of WCW and the departure of established Superstars like “Stone Cold” Steve Austin and The Rock, as well as makes the bold decision to split its roster between two brands.

2.o: With Vince McMahon’s declaration of Ruthless Aggression to the entire WWE locker room, a polarizing rookie Superstar attempts to grab the brass ring and shake things up. Enter John Cena. After enjoying initial success, Cena struggles to find himself as a performer and realizes he’s on on the brink of being fired — that is, until his adoption of new persona launches him to new heights. Featuring brand-new, never-before-heard commentary from The Dr. of Thuganomics himself.

3.o: As The Ruthless Aggression Era dawned, Triple H pushed forward the Evolution of sports-entertainment with Ric Flair, Randy Orton & Batista. Relive the formation and triumphs of the group that launched and revitalized the careers of its members and dominated WWE in the early-2000s. Find out what brought the four legends together and, for the first time ever, learn about the obstacles that threatened to derail Evolution from the start.

4.o: Seeking “The Next Big Thing,” WWE finds Brock Lesnar. He becomes an in-ring monster — and a master of Ruthless Aggression behind the scenes. Follow Brock Lesnar’s meteoric rise in WWE and get the full story behind his controversial and headline-making decision to abruptly leave in 2004 — at arguably the pinnacle of his young career — to pursue endeavors outside sports-entertainment. Relive Lesnar’s rise to the top, rivalries with The Rock and Hulk Hogan and his decision to depart WWE for eight years.

5.o: WWE's first-ever brand extension divides its roster and sparks civil war between Raw and SmackDown. As competition heats up between brands, Eddie Guerrero, JBL, Edge and others showcase Ruthless Aggression as they capitalize on their newfound opportunity to become stars. Go in depth on WWE’s groundbreaking decision to split its roster between two brands, Raw and SmackDown, from the myriad behind-the-scenes challenges, to the intense competition that erupted between the brands and their Superstars

1.o: When the WWE Universe begins to reject The People's Champion during his transition to Hollywood, The Rock embraces his newfound role as a despised antagonist, leading to one of the most entertaining runs in WWE history.

2.o: As WWE embarks on a new era, the creation of new innovative concepts such as Elimination Chamber, Money in The Bank and Taboo Tuesday invigorates WWE programming.

3.o: Female Superstars of WWE's Ruthless Aggression Era prove what they are truly capable of and carve out a substantial role for themselves in WWE.

4.o: After a four-year hiatus from the ring due to major back surgery, Shawn Michaels returns to WWE to write a new ending to his legendary career.

5.o: The early stages of WWE’s developmental system in OVW, along with other unconventional experiments such as WWE Tough Enough, usher in a new generation of Superstars headlined by Brock Lesnar, John Cena, Batista, Randy Orton and The Miz.

1.o: After his divorce, sports store owner Ralf is looking for a new purpose in life - and a new love. But is there anyone in Marburg he doesn't know? Bookseller Maria encounters an old rival - both her affair Max, and her father are just waiting for her to lose her temper. Things escalate - and lead to a surprising encounter.

2.o: After the argument with Johanna Augustin, Maria decides to write a book herself - easier said than done. And then her former best friend Nikki gets in touch. Maria avoids her problems and invites herself to go bowling with Sophie and her friends. Ralf spends the evening with his daughters, Lily and Lotta, trying to save what's left of his family.

3.o: Maria tries to come to terms with an unpleasant truth about Max. Her father also surprises her with an unexpected confession. Even the unwanted psychological advice from dog trainer Hakan doesn't help. And Ralf also has to deal with some bad news that changes his entire life - he gathers the whole family together for a big dinner...

4.o: Ralf wants to become a new man. Nikki forces Maria to have a day of reconciliation. They all end up at the "Holistic Healing Hatzfeld" wellness center at the same time: While Ralf and his friend Jochen face a dramatic firewalk there, Maria tries to avoid a serious conversation with Nikki. Will Maria and Ralf finally meet here?

5.o: Ralf is on the lookout: who is the mysterious woman who always writes on his car? After a misunderstanding, he suddenly has a dog and a date with a stranger that takes a completely unexpected turn. Maria also has a date - and gets carried away with an act that ends the day in disaster.

6.o: Max and Nikki's wedding is on the rocks, but Maria wants to save it - and finally draw a line under it and concentrate on her career as an author. Ralf has to take care of Schopenhauer's funeral - until he realizes that he has to stop the wedding.

7.o: After the scandal at the wedding, Maria flees to Cologne to talk to the publisher about her book idea. After a promising start, however, the conversation goes completely off the rails. Just a few streets away, Ralf says goodbye to his daughter Lily as she embarks on her future life as a student. A fateful coincidence?

8.o: Maria and Ralf try to understand what happened in Cologne. Meanwhile, Marburg is preparing for the city festival and a big comeback: The legendary Chaos-Pendulum is back! The ride on which Maria and Ralf almost met years ago. The brilliant finale?

1.o: The first contestants arrive for HYBE x Geffen's intensive training program, aiming to gain the skills needed to become stars — if they can make the cut.

2.o: As the girls focus on mastering dance fundamentals with a renowned instructor in LA, casting execs scout the globe for other contestants with star power.

3.o: The competition heats up when the focus shifts to finding an exceptional lead vocalist. Then, an innocent error creates a scandal that rocks the group.

4.o: The arrival of a new competitor shifts the group's dynamic. After a brutally honest evaluation, the girls get makeovers for their public debut.

5.o: As the survival show kicks off, the girls split into groups for a high-stakes performance mission, where fan votes determine which contestants advance.

7.o: An explosive elimination day shatters morale, prompting some to reconsider their place in the competition. Later, the group recreates iconic pop anthems.

8.o: After a year of intense training and competition, the top 10 perform in an emotional live finale, and the final lineup of KATSEYE is announced.

1.o: تتزلزل أركان عائلة بسيطة كانت تظن أن الأب هو السقف الذي يحميها، لتجد نفسها في مواجهة العراء بعد رحيله. وبينما يكافح الابن الأكبر بشرفٍ خلف مقود حافلة ليلمّ شتات ما تبقى، ينجرف الأخ الأصغر في تيار الجشع الأعمى، وتختار الأخت الطريق الأكثر ظلاماً بالانخراط في عالم الممنوعات بحثاً عن سلطة وهمية؛ لتصبح العائلة في مواجهةٍ شرسة مع شبح الانهيار الكامل الذي يهدد بتحويل ذكرياتهم الدافئة إلى رماد.
When a young man unleashes years of pent-up rage on a stranger who wronges his brother, the aftermath reveal layers of regret and resentment.

2.o: Invited back to his alma mater to speak, a popular actor takes the school's stage to recount his reckless, ridiculous antics as an unacademic teen.

3.o: Fixated on his radical theory on the human subconscious, a brilliant thinker realizes his ideas' potential, and risks, as he shares them with a friend.

4.o: Envious of his nephew's success in life, a discontented villager's simmering insecurity and resentment rear their ugly heads at a family wedding.

5.o: A group of soldiers face risky choices when a young boy, separated from his family while fleeing home, seeks their help in making a rescue.

6.o: Detained after committing a physical assault, a young man reflects on the troubling events that led to his action and its painful impact on his family.

7.o: An ordinary day takes a frightful — and fateful — turn for a young woman when a stranger arrives at her home.

8.o: A new official's grit and guts are tested when, after an ambush in the field, he is tasked with transporting a wily captive to police headquarters.

9.o: A musician hopes to jump-start his stagnant career overseas, but on the cusp of his departure, he meets a vocalist who sweeps him off his feet.

1.t: Head To a Place Where Hurricanes Hit
1.o: Qing Ye originally planned to study abroad to honor her late mother's wish. Everything changed after her father was framed by a colleague and wrongfully drawn into an investigation. Entrusted by her father, Sun Hai took her from Beijing to Zhazhating, where she can lie low for a while at her aunt Li Lanfang's place.

2.o: Qing Ye begins her new life in Zhazhating at Xing Wu's house, but the adjustment is anything but easy. Xing Wu finds her unreasonable, unaware that everything here is a world apart from the life Qing Ye once had.

3.o: Having just arrived, Qing Ye is caught in a torrential downpour. At the hotel, she clashes with a gold-chain-wearing tough guy over excessive noise, until Xing Wu shows up just in time to intervene.

4.o: Xing Wu fixes Qing Ye's laptop. He looks into her drive to check for missing files. Seeing how glamorous Qing Ye's life used to be, he can't help but feel that they are from different worlds.

5.o: Xing Wu takes Qing Ye to Zhao Mazi's pre-wedding banquet. It is Qing Ye's first time to see the lively open-air banquet in Zhazhating. She experiences Zhazhating's local customs and culture and gradually adapts to life there.

6.o: Qing Ye leaves Zhazhating to go back to Beijing. Xing Wu and Qing Ye take a photo together, leaving behind one last warm memory.

7.o: Qing Ye proposes revitalizing Xuandao by using promotional strategies to attract younger customers and drafts a detailed business plan.

8.o: Qing Ye successfully persuades "Zhazhating's Three Beauties" to be models for the Xuandao's promotional photos. Li Lanfang gives everyone beautiful styling, while Xing Wu finds Quan Ya to be in charge of photography.

9.o: Qing Ye learns that Shu Han and Xing Wu have been business partners for many years and senses that Shu Han has feelings for Xing Wu. Li Lanfang also tries her best to bring Xing Wu and Shu Han together.

10.t: Childhood Friend Appears Out of the Blue
10.o: Meng Ruihang makes a special trip from Beijing to Zhazhating to find Qing Ye and even invites her to go abroad together a week later.

11.o: Meng Ruihang asks Xing Wu to persuade Qing Ye to go abroad and return to her original path in life. Qing Ye is disappointed but doesn't give a clear answer.

12.o: The Academic Director, impressed by Qing Ye's English skills, invites her to sign up to host the visiting foreign guests. Meanwhile, Xing Wu bumps into his former homeroom teacher, Mr. Zhu, who urges him to return to school or risk being expelled.

13.o: Qing Ye and Ye Yingjian go to the school to prepare for the English Corner. During the initial English assessment, they find that the students' English level are extremely poor. Qing Ye gets a flash of inspiration and starts researching innovative English teaching methods at home.

14.o: Qing Ye wants to persuade Xing Wu to return to school, but she is disappointed to learn that Xing Wu might give up returning to school and choose to work in the Electronics Street.

15.t: Every Cloud Has a Silver Lining
15.o: Xuandao plans to reopen, while Grandma has recovered and been discharged from the hospital. Qing Ye no longer tries to persuade Xing Wu to return to school, believing that no matter which path he chooses, he'll end up where he wants to be.

16.o: Qing Ye identifies the poster using their profile picture and locks in on Cao Fan. At school, she confronts Cao Fan and proposes a bet using their monthly exam scores. The loser would have to run 20 laps.

17.t: I Just Want to Get a High School Diploma
17.o: Xing Wu and Qing Ye go to school together. Shu Han is devastated to learn that Xing Wu is giving up his job to go back to school.

18.t: I Want to Stay in School Too
18.o: Shi Min plucks up the courage to tell her father that she's determined to continue her studies and study art. Qing Ye suggests that Shi Min take the arts-track exam, and Mr. Zhu also helps talk her father around.

19.t: We Who Strive for the Gaokao
19.o: Xing Wu tells Qing Ye that he's decided to try for college, wanting to see what it's like to be a good student. Qing Ye is both surprised and delighted.

20.o: Xing Wu and Cao Ping meet at the fishing wharf. Cao Ping says he can't let go of their past feud and swears to make Xing Wu and those around him suffer.

21.t: Leave the Past Behind, and Welcome the Future
21.o: Qing Ye invites Cao Fan into their study group. Xing Wu joins in too, and they all buckle down to prepare for their final exams.

22.t: The Long Night of Chinese New Year
22.o: Xing Wu and Cao Ping meet at the fishing wharf. Cao Ping says he can't let go of their past feud and swears to make Xing Wu and those around him suffer.

23.t: Through Every Challenge, One at a Time
23.o: Xing Wu returns to the ruins of Xuandao, where Qing Ye comforts him with a hug. Sitting by the sea together, the two imagine the future and discuss how they might rebuild Xuandao.

24.t: We Who Aren't Good at Goodbyes
24.o: Everyone hides the fact that the money is gone from Grandma. Li Lanfang, Xing Wu, and Qing Ye stack their hands together and promise to work hard, starting over from scratch.

25.o: Qing Ye and Xing Wu delete each other's contact information, promising to reunite as their best selves. Xing Wu vows to catch up to her, and the two bid each other a final farewell.

26.o: As the final push for the Gaokao begins, Xing Wu gazes wistfully at Qing Ye's empty seat. Outside of his studies, he helps restore Xuandao. He unexpectedly discovers that the Welwitschia is showing signs of new life and continues to care for it diligently.

27.o: Qing Ye tells her father that she's decided to stay and study business at Qingbei. Xing Wu often keeps vigil at his grandmother's grave. He even dreams of reuniting with Qing Ye, but it is only a dream.

28.o: Xing Wu heads to Beijing for an internship, joining Aofei Group's rocket R&D project. Qing Ye buries herself in work, while Meng Ruihang remains by her side.

29.o: After Xing Wu arrives in Zhazhating, he searches everywhere for Qing Ye but can't find her. When the two finally reunite, there's no need for words. Years of feelings finally come pouring out.

30.o: Qing Hongzhi brings Xing Wu and Qing Ye to a golf course. Xing Wu showcases his impressive golf skills, causing Qing Hongzhi to see him in a new light.
